name: Graphlet Counting
problem_statement: Classify and count small connected induced subgraphs by their unlabeled isomorphism class, optionally including per-vertex orbit participation.

normalization: Reject directed input unless an explicit undirected projection is requested.
Collapse parallel edges into one undirected edge.

problem_inputs.name: graphlet_sizes
problem_inputs.constraints: unique values, each between 2 and 5 inclusive
problem_inputs.description: Vertex cardinalities of connected induced graphlets to count.

problem_inputs.name: result_limit_per_graphlet
problem_inputs.description: Maximum listed instances per graphlet class; counts remain exhaustive.

required_outputs.name: count_by_graphlet
required_outputs.description: Exact count of each connected induced isomorphism class.

required_outputs.name: graphlet_dictionary
required_outputs.description: Structural definition associated with each returned identifier.

solution_semantics.objective: Count every connected induced vertex set of requested size once under unlabeled graph isomorphism.
solution_semantics.exactness: Class counts and requested orbit counts are exact.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Each unordered data-graph vertex set contributes once.

validation_rules: Every instance is induced and connected.
Each instance is assigned to exactly one canonical graphlet class.
Orbit counts respect automorphism-equivalent vertex positions.
edge_cases: Requested size greater than the data-graph vertex count contributes zero.
For size two, each normalized edge is the sole connected graphlet type.
